name: Fishugly
look: a gangly walker on two long blue fin-legs with a big green fish head, a grimace of jagged fangs, black-ringed eyes, a black mop of fins and long blue arm-fins
entry: It wanders the riverbanks on its long fin-legs, staring at everything with its unblinking eyes. It buries itself in the mud to sleep, with only its grin showing.
how: Evolve Fangfosh at level 16. It learns Mud Shot when it evolves.
